answer_1.quote: We first used the GPT-4 evaluation from AlpacaEval to evaluate response quality on 805 instructions ... We also conducted evaluations on three other NLG benchmarks: Long-Form Question Answering (ELI5), Long-Form test set (LF-Test), and Super-NaturalInstructions (Super-NI).

answer_2.quote: For ELI5 and LF-Test, we followed ... to calculate the Rouge-L and Meteor scores. For Super-NI, we utilize Bert-Score for evaluation. We ran its scripts directly, using GPT-4 for evaluation.

answer_3.quote: We ran its scripts directly, using GPT-4 for evaluation. We calculated the win/tie/lose rates by comparing the model responses with the reference responses provided by the benchmarks.

answer_4.quote: Since the generated tasks may involve knowledge from several different domains, we require that the annotator needs to retrieve the corresponding evidence using the search engines ... The entire process of manual evaluation took approximately 8 man-hours. Human Evaluation Metrics. a) validation (V) indicates the percentage of the example whose response follows the instruction. b) hallucination (H) measures the percentage of the example whose response contains factual errors. c) fluency (F) indicates the percentage of the example that has instructions and responses that are smooth and fluent.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators evaluated each example for validation, hallucination, and fluency.
